boundary: Development/training manifest only. All sources have prior project exposure or lack verified patient identifiers; this is not patient-disjoint certification evidence.
known_limitations: DDR source export has no verified patient identifier; image_id is used as a pseudo-patient key, so DDR grouping is image-level and cannot establish patient-disjoint evaluation.
DDR grade 5 denotes ungradable images; the current trainer's grade>=2 referable score routes them to REFER and must not treat them as disease-positive ground truth.
DRTiD and DeepDRiD have been inspected in prior development; the combined manifest is not a sealed external certification cohort.
DeepDRiD suffix-to-anatomy mapping remains inferred rather than officially verified.
